foundation.title: Turn what you know into what you can say.
foundation.description: A focused English interview practice loop built around retrieval, transfer, and evidence of real progress.
foundation.actionHint: Foundation is ready for the first learning-loop slice.

calibration.readyCopy: Next, answer three short questions so FluentLoop can establish a provisional speaking baseline.
calibration.question: Question
calibration.processing: Saving your recording, then transcribing and analyzing it…
calibration.readOnly: Calibration transcripts are read-only so the baseline reflects your original spoken answer.
calibration.noCorrection: Answer naturally. FluentLoop will not interrupt or correct you mid-answer.
calibration.evolves: This profile is an initial observation, not a permanent score. It will evolve with evidence from later training.
calibration.ttsFallback: Audio is unavailable; read the visible question and continue.
calibration.micError: Microphone access is required to record an answer.

onboarding.promise: Turn what you know into what you can say.
onboarding.intro: Build a verified profile so every practice session can stay relevant to your real experience.
onboarding.confirmationSent: Check your email to confirm the account, then sign in.
onboarding.sourceIntro: Upload a text-based PDF or paste your background. You will review everything before it becomes part of your profile.
onboarding.backgroundPlaceholder: Paste your experience, projects, education, and skills…
onboarding.reviewIntro: Edit, add, or remove anything. Only confirmed fields become durable profile facts.
onboarding.storyWarning: Suggestions only — they are not stored as confirmed facts.
onboarding.completeCopy: FluentLoop can now personalize later practice using facts you reviewed and confirmed.
